# Chemtrails

> Chemtrails is a retro-futuristic synth-rock project from Portland, Oregon, exploring the strange space between memory, technology, desire, and the unknown. The music blends dreamy synth rock, cosmic disco, psychedelic pop, and vintage science fiction.

## Music

- Featured tracks (streamable on the site): Orbitz, Electric Little Heart, Paper Bag Teeth, The World "Jones" Made, King Tides, Black Halo Signal, Coastal Cathedral, The Last Space Boat To Mars (Instrumental), The Last Space Boat To Mars, Velvet Ferrari, Black Cat, The Creatures We Are All, Tonight, Ride On Stella, Neon Shadows, This House Grows, Winstons & Indian Food, Blue Line, Last Motel on Earth, Dust on My Boots
- Full catalog: https://suno.com/@gamecat2300
- Support: tip jar via PayPal (https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/W5HUHU7FYFXY8) and merch at https://chemtrails-music.myspreadshop.com/

## About

The artist behind Chemtrails is a West Coast musician and producer born on the Oregon coast — formerly guitarist, keyboardist, and producer with Venus In Spurs and Terra Firma. The solo work is built on ambient texture, cinematic atmosphere, and Pacific Northwest fog.
